credits.title: Butterfly Lovers
credits.overview: In the Eastern Jin Dynasty, Zhu Yingtai disguises herself as a man to attend school, where she meets Liang Shanbo. The two become close friends and classmates and eventually fall deeply in love. However, family opposition separates them, and Zhu Yingtai is forced to marry another man.
